execution_contract.inputs: one validated NpmSourceBlock, immutable block-start ReducerState, resolved block call scope, and hermetic provider trait
execution_contract.full_suffix: every request in the conservative full-envelope plan is evaluated before reduction, including requests contributed only by events after a would-be fatal reducer prefix
execution_contract.provider_results: Position Value/None, Pool Value/None, and Token Found/Missing are distinct resolved results; PossibleReorg, Unknown, and provider errors abort before reduction
execution_contract.provider_error_handling: provider error payloads are discarded; only a sanitized error kind, phase, and optional canonical request index appear in the host error
execution_contract.key_ownership: the executor constructs captured observation keys from canonical requests; the planner independently enforces exact resolved-frame key equality
execution_contract.audit: domain-separated deterministic SHA-256 binds source, planning state, scope, segment/profile identity, ordered request keys, resolved result classes, planned maxima, and reducer consumption coverage
execution_contract.provider_authority: only an explicitly HermeticFixture provider is accepted
